actionMeaning.routing: fast uses modeled PayPal supplier settlement. auto can use bank settlement when deadlines permit. Neither changes retail captures.
actionMeaning.modelRoles: The model ranks eligible contacts locally; the campaign is automatically applied. A smaller contact limit can discard positive-value opportunities shown in the preview.
